description: The desk's change window: the 20 most recently published pieces, newest first, with the desk's own dek, its computed split counts, and the story-chain ids each piece belongs to. This is the cheap 'what moved since I last looked' call — a few KB, not the multi-megabyte /feed.json — so a scheduled agent can poll it safely. Filter by date, kind, or chain. For anything older than the window, use list_audits with a date range.

chain.description: Only pieces belonging to this story chain, by chain id (e.g. 'mcconnell'). Chain ids come from get_chain with no arguments.

kind.description: Only pieces of this kind: 'audit', 'coverage', 'dispatch', or 'solo'.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (default and ceiling: 20, the whole window).

since.description: Only pieces dated on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD). If it predates the window, the result says so in `truncated` rather than implying the corpus starts there.

name: whats_new
